🚨 India’s First Case of #HMPV Detected in Bengaluru 🚨

An 8-month-old baby, with no travel history, has been diagnosed with Human Metapneumovirus (#HMPV). The infant is currently receiving treatment at a private hospital.

Stay informed. Stay cautious. 🛡️

#HealthAlert https://t.co/oXM73XJOei
